notes.title: Vote for Nova Strike in the Steam Award!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423266/b02d6c9ec8d352b68a098887387a7cd49b1e6583.png[/img]

What could be more satisfying and relaxing than unleashing the power of your blaster cannons to take on waves of enemies in this retro shoot'em up with procedural levels?

Vote for Nova Strike in the "Sit Back and Relax" category to show your support for the game!
